title: Grateful Dead Live at University Hall, University Of Virginia on 1982-09-14
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000 > Adobe Audition > Samplitude Pro X6 Suite > FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy fall‑1982 show with standout Lazy Lightning, Supplication, Deal and a killer High Time.
ai_review.review: The patched SBD source delivers crystal‑clear audio that fans describe as a massive sonic upgrade, despite the first couple of songs being cut off. The performance is praised for its loose, slippery vibe and fire‑filled atmosphere, highlighted by Lazy Lightning > Supplication > Deal and an incendiary High Time. Overall the show captures the Dead at their 1982 peak with superb sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give high marks (4‑5 stars) and explicitly praise both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; minor cut‑off issue does not detract from an overall exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: High‑fidelity, crisp SBD capture with a massive sonic upgrade; only drawback is the first couple of songs are cut off.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows tightly with a loose, slippery feel that matches the sweaty, packed hall; transitions are fluid and energy stays high throughout.
